title: Protocolo PRISMA para revisión sistemática y bibliométrica desde el enfoque institucionalista
author: Emmanuel Estrada Vicencio

steps.title: Define Search Strategy
steps.instruction: Construct iterative search strings combining terms related to transparency, access to information, and accountability in the public sector, as well as governance, implementation, and institutional capacity in both English and Spanish.

steps.title: Execute Database Search
steps.instruction: Perform systematic searches in Scopus and SciELO for peer-reviewed scientific articles and reviews published between 2002 and 2026 using the following specific strings:

substeps.instruction: Scopus: Apply to TITLE-ABS-KEY: (( "government transparency" OR "public transparency" OR "freedom of information" OR "access to public information" OR "open government" OR "right to information" OR "proactive disclosure" OR "FOIA" OR "FOI" OR "transparency policy" OR "public sector transparency" OR "administrative transparency" OR "e-government transparency" ) AND ( "institutional" OR "institutionalism" OR "institutional theory" OR "institutional change" OR "institutional framework" OR "governance" OR "accountability" OR "public policy" OR "implementation" OR "compliance" OR "bureaucracy" )) AND NOT ( "corporate transparency" OR "financial transparency" OR "market transparency" OR "supply chain" OR "clinical trial" OR "healthcare transparency" OR "tax transparency" OR "banking transparency" OR "corporate governance" OR "business ethics" OR "CSR" OR "corporate social responsibility" OR "ESG" OR "artificial intelligence" OR "machine learning" OR "algorithmic transparency" OR "explainability" OR "LLM" OR "generative AI" OR "neural network" OR "blockchain" OR "data mining" ) AND PUBYEAR > 2001 AND ( LIMIT-TO ( DOCTYPE , "ar" ) OR LIMIT-TO ( DOCTYPE , "re" ) ) AND ( LIMIT-TO ( SUBJAREA , "SOCI" ) OR LIMIT-TO ( SUBJAREA , "POLI" ) OR LIMIT-TO ( SUBJAREA , "BUSI" ) )

SciELO: Apply string: (ti:("transparencia gubernamental" OR "transparencia pública" OR "acceso a la información pública" OR "gobierno abierto" OR "derecho a la información" OR "rendición de cuentas" OR "government transparency" OR "freedom of information" OR "open government" OR "right to information") AND ab:("institucionalismo" OR "teoría institucional" OR "cambio institucional" OR "marco institucional" OR "isomorfismo" OR "path dependence" OR "dependencia de trayectoria" OR "instituciones formales" OR "instituciones informales" OR "desacoplamiento" OR "institucionalismo histórico" OR "nuevo institucionalismo" OR "institutionalism" OR "institutional theory" OR "institutional change" OR "governance" OR "accountability" OR "implementación de políticas")

steps.title: Manage Records and Remove Duplicates
steps.instruction: Export recovered records to Rayyan.ai and perform a deduplication process to ensure each document is evaluated only once.

steps.title: Perform Initial Screening
steps.instruction: Screen titles and abstracts in Rayyan.ai using binary decisions (include/exclude) based on the following criteria:

substeps.instruction: Inclusion Criteria (I1-I5): (I1) Peer-reviewed articles/reviews 2002-2026; (I2) Focus on transparency, public information access, or open government; (I3) English or Spanish language; (I4) Indexed in Scopus or SciELO; (I5) Incorporates at least one institutionalist concept/mechanism/framework.

Exclusion Criteria (E1-E7): (E1) Corporate/financial/market transparency; (E2) Algorithmic transparency/AI/LLMs; (E3) Corporate ethics/CSR; (E4) No abstract available; (E5) Non-peer-reviewed (book chapters, theses, reports); (E6) Metaphorical use of 'transparency' (e.g., physics/chemistry); (E7) Tangential reference to transparency.

steps.title: Evaluate Eligibility and Define Corpus
steps.instruction: Perform a full-text eligibility evaluation of the retained studies to confirm thematic and analytical relevance, establishing the final corpus for bibliometric and institutionalist analysis.

steps.title: Conduct Bibliometric Analysis (PQ1)
steps.instruction: Analyze the final corpus (expected scale 10²–10³ records) using VOSviewer and other mapping tools to identify structural patterns.

substeps.instruction: Analyze co-occurrence of keywords/terms from titles and abstracts.
Analyze author and journal collaboration networks.
Create a journal hierarchy table based on publication and citation frequency.
Apply minimum frequency filters and standard normalization if map legibility is compromised.

steps.title: Identify Institutionalist Approaches (PQ2)
steps.instruction: Apply a multi-level analytical strategy to identify institutionalist frameworks within the corpus:

substeps.instruction: Level F1 (Explicit): Detect theoretical labels in titles, abstracts, and keywords (e.g., 'institutionalism', 'new institutionalism', 'historical institutionalism', 'sociological institutionalism').

Level F2 (Vocabulary): Use automatic/semi-automatic filtering for terms like 'institutional capacity', 'implementation', 'compliance', 'formal/informal institutions', 'institutional change', or 'governance'.

Level F3 (Implicit): Identify studies addressing 'norm-practice gaps', 'selective implementation', 'administrative discretion', 'street-level bureaucracy', or 'organizational inertia' even if explicit terminology is absent.

steps.title: Validate and Synthesize Institutionalist Analysis
steps.instruction: Validate the identified mechanisms (F1-F3) and synthesize the findings to classify the studies.

substeps.instruction: Analytical Validation: Confirm that institutional mechanisms operate as explanatory variables (linking rules, incentives, or routines to observable results) rather than mere context.
Synthesis and Classification: Classify validated studies by institutionalist variant (e.g., rational, sociological, historical, or mixed) and specific institutional mechanisms.
